name: local-cpu-v2
description: Round 2 of the local CPU bench (2026-08-11): the judge is the bottleneck, so this config isolates the judge variable. Vision is held constant across all three ensembles (LFM2.5-VL x3, variants a/c/d — the n=3 lite profile) and only the judge changes: hardened prompt + bounded schema on the same LFM2.5-2.6B, then a Qwen3-4B judge, then the same LFM judge with bounded reasoning ON. Plus a Qwen3-VL-8B single-shot row so a local model is measured against the cloud pilot's strongest single-shot. Ports MUST match eval/serve/models.json: lfm-vl 8081, lfm-judge 8082, qwen-vl 8084, qwen-judge 8085, lfm-judge-think 8086. Start the servers with eval/serve/serve.sh first (see eval/SERVING.md). Cost fields are 0 by construction — latency and RAM are the currency.

lfm_vl._note: LFM2.5-VL-1.6B Q8_0 via llama-server --jinja --mmproj. Held constant across every ensemble in this config so the judge is the only variable.

lfm_judge._note: LFM2.5-2.6B Q8_0, text-only, reasoning OFF. Same server as local-cpu.json — what changes vs the 2026-08-11 run is the harness side: hardened judge prompt + bounded judge schema (maxItems 6), which llama-server compiles into the GBNF.

qwen_vl._note: Qwen3-VL-8B, single-shot only. The cloud pilot's best single-shot row (92.9% recall) was this model — this measures what it costs on CPU locally.

qwen_judge._note: Qwen3-4B, text-only judge — the 'try a stronger judge' lever from runs/2026-08-11-local-lfm/SCORING.md finding 2.

lfm_judge_think._note: Same LFM2.5-2.6B weights as lfm_judge but served with bounded reasoning ENABLED — the 'judge is only 1 call, spend the ~60s there' lever. Longer timeout because the reasoning trace precedes the JSON.

ensemble_lfm_hardjudge.label: LFM2.5-VL x3 (a/c/d) + LFM2.5-2.6B judge, hardened prompt + bounded schema, CPU

ensemble_lfm_qwenjudge.label: LFM2.5-VL x3 (a/c/d) + Qwen3-4B judge, hardened prompt + bounded schema, CPU

ensemble_lfm_thinkjudge.label: LFM2.5-VL x3 (a/c/d) + LFM2.5-2.6B judge with reasoning ON, hardened prompt + bounded schema, CPU
